title: Unlock new levels of realism with Simvoice Copilot #flightgaming #realism
description:
Tired of hunting for tiny knobs or softkeys with a mouse while hand-flying in turbulence or VR? In this video, we build a hands-free Garmin G1000 workflow using SimVoice Copilot v1.1.6 https://simvoicecopilot.com/hitfs (Use code: JVELDH10) native H-events.

Unlike basic push-to-talk macros, native H-events tap directly into the simulator's internal avionics wiring. Combined with live SimVar telemetry, we can configure dynamic, multi-step voice commands—like a single phrase that arms your flight director, calculates target climb speeds based on pressure altitude, and executes full flight-level-change climb logic automatically.
